name: Brunost (brown cheese)
about: Brunost is Norway's signature caramel-sweet brown cheese, made from goat and cow milk whey. It is a daily staple across Oslo and the rest of the country.
tip: Ask the shop to keep it cold, and check that your airline or home country allows it in your luggage.

name: Selbu mittens (wool gloves)
about: Selbu mittens are knitted wool gloves with an eight-pointed star pattern, a classic Norwegian design. They reflect the country's long knitting tradition.
tip: Check whether a pair is hand-knitted or machine-made, since the label or shop staff can tell you.
